range_rule: actual low/high of the selected window; LOWER < low+1/3 width; MIDDLE between one-third and two-thirds; UPPER > low+2/3 width; residence is classified by close, attack aggregates are separately marked by boundary touch

boundary_touch_attack_aggregates.warning: These are descriptive bar aggregates, not independent attacks or a synthetic score. Extension and retention are kept separate.

key_sequences.observation: SELL effort 20.7 BTC at 00:50 produced 24.3 USD retained downside; later SELL 26.7 BTC at 00:53 and 28.2 BTC at 00:54 produced 9.1 and 14.1 USD retained downside. BUY 42.9 BTC at 00:58 reclaimed 26.8 USD, but SELL returned the close to 84437.1 at 00:59.

SELL 12.7 BTC at 01:15 and 53.9 BTC at 01:16 produced 10.8 and 37.3 USD retained downside. The 01:17 mixed-flow bar had BUY 57.5 BTC but only 4.4 USD upside retained from its open. BUY 34.8 BTC at 01:20 then obtained 33.7 USD retained upside.

SELL 37.7 BTC at 01:24 produced a downside wick but close rose above open, so retained result was -6.1 USD. The next smaller SELL effort 14.4 BTC at 01:25 produced 19.1 USD downside. This is a failed attack followed by a successful reattack, not systematic SELL failure.

SELL 63.2 BTC at 01:50 produced 37.3 USD retained downside; SELL 34.6 BTC at 01:55 produced 19.6; SELL 35.8 BTC at 01:57 made a new low 84437.5 but retained only 7.0 USD. BUY 24.6 BTC at 01:58 reclaimed 23.7 USD. At 02:00 delta was -0.8 BTC but close rose, then BUY 8.2 and 8.6 BTC at 02:02-02:03 advanced to 84503.0.

SELL 13.6 BTC at 02:05 produced almost no downside close progress. BUY at 02:10 produced 8.7 USD, and BUY 5.8 BTC at 02:15 produced 12.7 USD from open but did not create a new high beyond the earlier 84503.0 local area.

oi.interpretation: The available 5m OI changes are negative in the sampled portions, consistent with risk destruction/deleveraging context, but they do not identify position side. No complete verified 5m OI level/change sequence is available for every bucket.

snapshot_as_of_0215.less_effective_side: BUY at the upper boundary, specifically on retained result rather than raw extension
snapshot_as_of_0215.where_effort_failed: Upper-boundary BUY effort produced 241.5 USD summed extension on 341.3 BTC BUY effort but only 15.5 USD summed retained close result; the descriptive retained result per BUY BTC was about 0.0454 USD/BTC. In contrast, lower-boundary SELL produced 62.2 USD summed retained downside on 497.0 BTC SELL effort, about 0.1251 USD/BTC.
snapshot_as_of_0215.acceptance_evidence: There is evidence that BUY repeatedly had difficulty retaining the highest excursions, especially 01:17 and 01:24-01:25 context, but not a universal failure on every upper test. SELL also had a clear retention degradation at 01:57.
snapshot_as_of_0215.ease_of_movement: The strongest low-effort opposite-side response was BUY 24.6 BTC at 01:58 for 23.7 USD retained upside, followed by BUY 8.2 and 8.6 BTC at 02:02-02:03 for further progress. This improved local BUY response did not yet establish a full-window directional conclusion.
snapshot_as_of_0215.directional_hypothesis: WEAK WORKING HYPOTHESIS: BUY efficiency was improving after the 01:57 SELL retention failure, while SELL had shown stronger aggregate lower-zone retained result. As of 02:15 there was NO decisive directional asymmetry.
snapshot_as_of_0215.confirmation_required: Repeated BUY retained progress that creates and holds a new local high beyond the 84503 area while SELL reattacks fail; alternatively, renewed SELL retained downside would invalidate the BUY hypothesis.
snapshot_as_of_0215.invalidation: A fresh effective SELL attack that restores lower prices, or a BUY upper attack that retains its new extreme rather than only producing wick extension.

post_snapshot_outcome.immediate_countermove: 02:17-02:19 SELL moved price from 84502.8 to 84445.5 with retained downside; this temporarily contradicted the weak BUY hypothesis.
post_snapshot_outcome.interpretation: The later outcome was an UP departure, but it does not rewrite the NO CLEAR ASYMMETRY snapshot at 02:15.

research_notes: One independent balance case. Detector events, if later overlaid, must remain observations and must not define the raw causal conclusion.

snapshot_as_of_0230.main_observation: Initial BUY burst had large effort and poor retention at 00:37; SELL later obtained repeated lower-zone results; BUY showed improving ease after the 01:57 SELL retention failure, but no decisive asymmetry by 02:30.
